content.comment_body: Hello, does anyone know if the MAC address of [product_name] [version_no] can be accessed from a particular Modbus register?

analysis.insight_summary: A user wants to read the MAC address from a [product_name] [version_no] device using a Modbus register, but learns this feature is not available. This shows a limitation in how this product can be integrated or identified via Modbus, which could be important for users managing networked automation equipment.
analysis.user_expectations: User expects that the [product_name] [version_no] device would allow its MAC address to be read externally through a Modbus register.
